架構雙視圖（候選）

UI / Tauri → owning application input → domain / S1
application → output Port ← native adapter
M03 facade → M04 DocumentOwner → one S1 session
M04 / M06 / M07 → M05 material input → immutable blob Port
No callback into document owner while catalog lease held.
